risks.title: Dependence on cargo contract with Amazon
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the concentration of the 'Cargo business with Amazon' as a risk. This concentration is weighted by the contract's criticality to a significant portion of operations. The improved agreement signed in June 2024 (A R ATSA) remains a key element of the strategy.

risks.title: Volatility in fuel and operating costs
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights the 'price and availability of aircraft fuel and our ability to control other costs' as a key risk. The strength of the language and the context of the airline industry justify a high severity rating.

risks.title: Intense competition in the airline sector
risks.score_rationale: The risk related to 'operate in an exceedingly competitive industry' is clearly identified. The airline industry is inherently competitive, making this factor particularly relevant. Low-cost carriers (LCC) and ultra-low-cost carriers (ULCC) exert significant competitive pressure.

risks.title: Risks related to the merger transaction with Allegiant
risks.score_rationale: Several points mention 'Expenses, litigation, or disruption to our business relating to the pending Merger' and 'Failure to receive regulatory approvals required to complete the Merger'. The Merger Agreement signed on January 11, 2026, for acquisition by Allegiant Travel Company justifies a high severity rating.

risks.title: Technological dependency and third-party systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk 'Our reliance on our and third-party technology and systems' is mentioned. Although less critical than others, technological dependency is a key factor in the airline sector, particularly for global distribution systems (GDS) such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

risks.title: General economic conditions and inflation
risks.score_rationale: The 'Changes in economic conditions, including inflationary pressures' are cited as a risk. This macroeconomic factor has a direct impact on demand and costs in the air transportation sector.

risks.title: Personnel-related risks and labor relations
risks.score_rationale: The document refers to 'loss of key personnel, increased labor costs, union disputes, employee strikes'. Labor relations and workforce management are critical for an airline. The company has collective bargaining agreements with ALPA (pilots), AMFA (technicians), IBT (flight attendants), and TWU (dispatchers).
